_reflex_review_in_flight answers on pointer_path(...).exists() alone, while the same recorded-dispatch rule at reckon/crew/recovery.py:833 also requires read_pointer() to return a record; a pointer file that exists but is unreadable therefore leaves review-missing withheld here while the reflex is free to dispatch another review, which is the two readers disagreeing in exactly the state this node exists to keep them agreeing in.
